_: Phase 0 selector registry for the replay auto-execution harness. Captured 2026-09-12 against TradingView Desktop 3.4.1.8194 (Chrome/146.0.7680.216, Electron 41.7.1), layout 'Trial Ground', ICMARKETS:XAUUSD @ 45S, Bar Replay ACTIVE, Replay Broker connected.
_read_this_first: The DOM is NOT the recommended control path. Every replay-toolbar control and every order intent in the spec has a named, semantic in-page API (see api_registry). The DOM entries exist because Phase 0 asked for them, and because two things (the 'Open Replay Trading' arming button and the qty field) have no confirmed API equivalent. Confidence describes survival across a TradingView update, not correctness today.

_phase0_5_invariants.note: Both stated section-1 invariants ("one page target", "one study") are FALSE as written. See src/internals/invariants.js for what was implemented instead, and why.

_phase0_6_chart_state.the_29_were_alert_labels: CORRECTION to Phase 0.5. The 29 "drawings" are AlertLabel sources, one per active price alert. They are rendered from the alert service and do NOT appear in the saved layout.
_phase0_6_chart_state.SAVECHART_IS_NOT_A_SAVE: TradingViewApi.saveChart(cb) only serialises to JSON and hands it to the callback - it never reaches the server. The real save is _saveChartService.saveExistentChart(before, ok, err). NOTE the hazard in _doSave: it assigns location.href when location.pathname === "/chart/".

api_registry._: Preferred path. All roots reachable from the page global with no click synthesis.

replay_depth.WARNING: Do NOT call getReplayDepth(arg). Source is getReplayDepth(e){ if(e) this.enableReplayMode(false); return this._replayDepth } - the argument is not a resolution, it is a flag that MUTATES replay mode.

_phase0_5_depth._: MEASURED. The Phase 0 UNKNOWN is closed, and the repo belief that 45s history is a rolling ~20k-bar window is wrong about replay SEEK depth.
_phase0_5_depth.selecting_the_boundary_instant: 0 bars - there is nothing before it to draw
_phase0_5_depth.behaviour_before_the_floor: CLAMPED, NOT REFUSED. _onPointSelected does Math.max(depth, t-1) and fires a "replay_time_point_corrected" notification. There is no refusal to walk backwards into.
_phase0_5_depth.per_resolution_reading: The seconds tier shares ONE floor; ticks have their own, shorter one. Not a placeholder, and not backwards.
_phase0_5_depth.caveat: Seek depth is NOT study history depth. That replay can START at 2024-06-03 does not mean B15 computes a full book from there. Unmeasured.
_phase0_5_depth.step_granularity: UNKNOWN - the session wedged before it could be measured.

session_control._phase0_5_wedge_warning: A replay session can enter a state where doStep() returns a promise that NEVER SETTLES and autoplay advances nothing, while reporting itself connected, started and unfinished (sessionState 2, replayStatus 3). Measured 2026-09-12 after arming Replay Trading and issuing ~15 selectDate calls in quick succession. NOT recoverable by stopReplay+start, leaveReplay, removing the <chartId>_additional replay model, or disconnectionSessionIfExists - all four tried. Recovery is a chart reload. Any loop MUST treat a non-advancing step as a hard failure; core/replay.js step() now throws rather than reporting a stale success.

_phase0_6_step_granularity.first_step_note: The first step from a start instant that is not on a bar boundary snaps to the boundary (30s here, from 23:59:59), then steps 45s per bar.

_phase0_6_recovery.wedge_recovery: A chart reload clears it. The reload does NOT resume the session - replay is left OFF (isReplayStarted false, isInReplay false, currentBroker null) and must be restarted.
_phase0_6_recovery.single_flight: src/internals/replay-transport.js serialises selectDate/step/play/pause/stop and REFUSES a selectDate while a step is in flight.
_phase0_6_recovery.health_read: replay_health tool; classifyHealth distinguishes healthy / wedged / stalled / armed_unprobed. No status FLAG distinguishes wedged from healthy - only a probe does.

_phase0_6_bar_integrity._: Deep 45S bars are GENUINE, not derived or upsampled.
_phase0_6_bar_integrity.skipped_bars_are_the_clincher: The 90s deltas at depth are 45s windows in which no tick printed. An upsample interpolates; it never skips. That is the strongest single evidence against synthesis.
_phase0_6_bar_integrity.relative_range_reading: Regime, not data quality: the within-2026 spread (0.0164-0.0249) is as wide as most cross-era gaps, and gold more than doubled over the period.
_phase0_6_bar_integrity.usable_depth: the full seek depth - the bars never start looking synthetic
_phase0_6_bar_integrity.UNMEASURED_AND_GATING: Whether a STUDY computes a correct book at a deep replay start. Replay serves only ~300-600 bars around the cursor while build15 declares max_bars_back 3000 and PS runs sma(atr,100). Do not treat a deep-replay book as out-of-sample evidence until warm-up is measured.

session_settings._: OVERTURNS the Phase 0 conclusion that the replay session has no capital / currency / commission. It has all three - not on the broker, which genuinely has no account-settings surface, but on a separate replay-strategy property bag. accountSettingsInfo() throws BY CONSTRUCTION (its own source requires supportCreateAccount || supportResetAccount || supportChangeAccountSettings, and the Replay Broker carries none of them), so no session state could ever have made it answer.
session_settings.discovered_via: equityCapability.getEquity(), which reads initialCapital from getUserInputSettings()

commission_type.note: An axis the brief did not name. Defaults to percent; B15 itself models cash_per_contract 0.11/side. Set it explicitly rather than inheriting percent.

session_settings.NOT_THE_STRATEGY_TESTER: B15 own initial_capital strategy property (in_330) reads 100000; this object reads 1000000. Different objects. The [data-qa-id="initial-capital"] pill remains the WRONG surface - the dom_registry warning about it still stands.

_phase0_6_equity_semantics._: P7 REFUTED. getEquity() does NOT track unrealised P&L.

while_open.verdict: equity did not move at all while the position was open

_phase0_6_equity_semantics.reading: getEquity() = initial capital + REALISED P&L - commissions. For unrealised, read positions()[i].unrealizedPl or reportData.position.openPL.

_phase0_6_writes_confirmed._: A6 SETTLED. setValue on replayStudyStrategyProperties children takes effect.
_phase0_6_writes_confirmed.independent_confirmation: equityCapability.getEquity() followed the capital write (1000000 -> 100000), and the realised book charged 0.22 round turn = 2 x 0.11, so commission_type/value reached the matching engine.

replay_transport._: The transport the broker capabilities sit on, reached via activeBroker()._brokerConnection._brokerConnection.currentAccountApi().placeOrderCapability._transport. Semantic, typed, and it carries the session-scoped reads the harness needs.
